---
title: "Downloads"
---

Everything on this site comes from files in our repository. You can download all
our data.

## Predictions

Prediction files live in the repository under each group folder, named by model and
date. They are plain CSV with one row per species.

[Repository](https://github.com/datadiversitylab/risk_database)

## The site data

The JSON the site reads is served alongside it, so it works as an API without any
further setup.

`data/index.json` holds one entry per species, with the consensus prediction.

`data/species/<id>.json` holds the full record for one species, including every
prediction made for it.

`data/groups.json` and `data/release.json` hold coverage and release metadata.

## Citing a release

Cite the release you used, not the site in general. Predictions change between releases,
and a citation without a version cannot be checked later.

Each release is archived with a DOI at [TBD].

## What is not here

No IUCN Red List data is stored or served by this site. Assessments, categories,
narratives, threat codes, and range polygons are available within the IUCN.
